items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals due to glute injury; no plans for IR.
items.why: Glute injury from Week 1; HC confirms no IR plans.
items.implication: Backup QB starts; impacts SEA skill players volume/efficiency.

items.text: Ravens placing WR Ja'Kobi Lane on IR after wrist surgery; out minimum four games.
items.why: Wrist surgery to quicken recovery; min 4 games.
items.implication: Opens targets for Bateman and others behind Flowers.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman upgrade in target share.

items.text: De'Zhaun Stribling (ankle) placed on IR; Deebo Samuel and Demarcus Robinson as primary beneficiaries for increased role/snaps.
items.why: Ankle injury/surgery; out at least 4 weeks (up to 10).
items.implication: Deebo sees uptick in slot routes/targets as he led them in Week 1.

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins was limited at practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring injury noted on first practice report of week; history of missing time with same issue.
items.implication: Monitor Thursday practice; potential limited targets or absence boosts other HOU WRs.
items.opportunity: If out or limited, increased target share for remaining HOU pass-catchers.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.why: Full practice return after ankle injury that kept him out Week 1.
items.implication: Likely shares with Stevenson; reduces Stevenson's standalone value.
items.opportunity: Potential RB2/flex if role expands; monitor snap share.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring after MNF; estimated report as non-participant.
items.implication: Status uncertain for Week 2 vs JAC; could elevate other DEN RBs if sidelined.

items.text: 49ers TE Jake Tonges out for season after surgery for torn MCL.
items.implication: Kittle full TE1; other TE depth promoted.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, DNP/limited Wednesday, but expects to play Sunday.
items.why: Back tightness; got mental reps and self-reports expectation to play.
items.implication: Keep in lineups; monitor further practices.
items.opportunity: Full CIN offense if plays; Chase/Higgins usage intact.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) did not practice Wednesday; day-to-day.
items.why: Aggravated hamstring from Week 1; day-to-day per coach.
items.implication: Prepare replacements; Bateman upside if out.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week amid Stribling IR and slot role.
items.why: Role expansion with Stribling out; led slot routes Week 1.

items.text: ETR Week 2 injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey=Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane=Bateman; Stribling=Deebo; Kamara=Kendre Miller; AJ Brown=Doubs. Streaming and FAAB guidance included.
items.why: Precise mapping of OUT/IR players to available replacements based on depth chart and Week 1 usage.
items.implication: Prioritize these adds for immediate opportunity.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in KC debut: 29/32 early RB opps, 19 routes, 6 targets (22%), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominant opportunity share as expected in new offense.
items.implication: Elite RB1 ROS with pass-game involvement.

items.text: ETR first Rest of Season Top-150 rankings show live with Levitan et al discussing CMC, Travis Etienne, Rashee Rice, Ashton Jeanty and more as if drafting today.
Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but played a horrific game; buy low on opportunity.
items.why: High xFP from targets/location/depth not reflected in actual FPs due to poor execution.
items.opportunity: Continued high target quality in DET offense.
